ADR-0009: Transfer billing-api ownership from Sana Petrov to Luca Ostrander
Author: Selma Marsh
Draft opened: 2026-08-31. Status: accepted on 2026-09-22.
Context: Sana Petrov is moving to full-time work on the Ledger Hardening project, and billing-api releases are tied to the platform release train.
Decision: Ownership of billing-api transfers from Sana Petrov (Payments) to Luca Ostrander (Platform) effective 2026-09-22. Sana Petrov stays available as backup for 30 days.
Consequences: Escalations for billing-api go to Luca Ostrander. The service catalog entry changes accordingly.
